fusions.name: Decoy Spread
fusions.desc: Skims 3 decoys out at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 20% chance to turn the target against its allies for 2.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Becalmed
fusions.desc: Drops a weight of still water on the target that deals 26 damage, always as a critical hit, and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unruffled
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Rolls Off the Back
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it, and your armour rises by 6%.
